input.current_sentence: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
input.context_before: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
input.context_after: Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.
input.selected_text: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.

output.sentence_type: 并列句（由并列连词 but 连接两个独立限定分句）
output.main_clause: The team has pockets of greatness in design; it still struggles to deliver consistently.
structure_breakdown: 第一分句：主语 The team + 谓语 has + 宾语 pockets of greatness + 范围状语 in design。
第二分句：主语 it（指代 the team）+ 谓语 struggles + 不定式补足成分 to deliver consistently。
并列连词 but 连接两个独立分句，表转折对比关系。
logic_relations: 与前句“客观评估团队表现”构成承接，给出评估的具体结论。
与后句“将优势融入日常流程”构成因果铺垫，点明问题所在。
information_hierarchy: 先肯定团队在设计领域存在零散的优秀表现，再转折指出其交付不稳定的核心问题。
转折后为信息重点，突出团队当前的主要短板。
style_features: 两个分句长度相近，结构对称，形成清晰的转折对比。
用词简洁务实，符合职场绩效评估的表达风格。
grammar_points: pockets of + 抽象名词表示“零散分布的少量某类特质”，pocket 用复数形式。
struggle 后接 to-infinitive 作补足成分，说明艰难完成的具体动作。
wording_notes: pockets of greatness 是比喻用法，指局部、零散的优秀表现，而非整体优秀。
deliver 在此为职场常用动词，指“交付成果、兑现表现”。

translations.label: 直译
translations.text: 这个团队在设计领域有一些零散的优秀之处，但它仍然难以稳定地交付成果。

translations.label: 意译
translations.text: 这个团队在设计上有不少亮点，但整体表现不够稳定。

translation_notes: pockets of greatness 不宜直译为“伟大的口袋”，需转化为符合中文职场表达的“零散亮点”。
evidence: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.
